translation.name: Luda yã takada kũ Bisã yão

content: Sɑnɑm mɛ sinɑm beni Osiɑsi kɑ Yotɑmu kɑ Akɑsi kɑ Esekiɑsi bɑ bɑndu di di Yudɑn temɔ, kɑ sɑɑ ye Yeroboɑmu Yoɑsin bii u bɑndu dii Isirelin temɔ, sɑnɑm mɛyɑ Yinni Gusunɔ u kɑ Osee Berin bii gɑri kuɑ.
Gɑri yi Yinni Gusunɔ u gbiɑ u Osee sɔ̃ɔwɑ yi wee. U nɛɛ,

content.text: Osee, ɑ doo ɑ kurɔ suɑ wi u rɑ sɑkɑrɑru ko.
Bɛɛn bibu bɑ koo mɑɑ win yirɑ swĩi.
Domi Isirelibɑ bɑ bũnu gɑsirimɔ bɑ sɑ̃ɑmɔ
nge kurɔ sɑkɑrɑ wi u durɔbu gɑsirimɔ.
Mɑ bɑ nɛ, Yinni Gusunɔ deri.

content: Mɑ Osee u seewɑ u Gomɛɛ Dibilɑimun bii suɑ kurɔ. Yerɑ u kɑ nùn mɛnnɑ. Mɑ kurɔ wi, u gurɑ suɑ u nùn bii tɔn durɔ mɑruɑ.

content.text: i bii wi yĩsiru kɛ̃ɛyɔ Yisirɛɛli.
Domi sɑɑ fiiko sɔɔ kon Yehun yɛnugibu wɔri
yèn sɔ̃ bɑ tɔmbun yɛm yɑri Yisirɛɛliɔ,
Tɔ̃ɔ te sɔɔ, kon Isirelibɑn tɑbu durɔbun tɛnnu bɔɔku Yisirɛɛlin wɔwɑɔ.

content: Yenibɑn biru, Gomɛɛ u mɑɑ gurɑ suɑ mɑ u bii tɔn kurɔ mɑrɑ. Mɑ Yinni Gusunɔ u Osee sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ,

content.text: ɑ nùn yĩsiru kɛ̃ɛyɔ Lo Ruhɑmɑ.
Yen tubusiɑnɑ bii wi bɑ yinɑ.
Domi nɑ ǹ mɑɑ Isirelibɑ wɔnwɔndu kuɑmmɛ.

content: Adɑmɑ kon Yudɑbɑ wɔnwɔndu kuɑ, kpɑ nɛn tii n bu fɑɑbɑ ko nɛ wi nɑ sɑ̃ɑ Gusunɔ ben Yinni. Adɑmɑ n ǹ mɔ kon kɑ ben yibɛrɛbɑ tɑbu ko. Nɑ ǹ tɛndu dendimɔ ǹ kun mɛ tɑkobi ǹ kun mɛ dumi kɑ yin mɑɑsɔbu.
Yenibɑn biru, Gomɛɛ u bii wi bom kɑrɑ. Mɑ u wure u gurɑ suɑ u bii tɔn durɔ mɑrɑ.

content.text: ɑ nùn yĩsiru kɛ̃ɛyɔ Lo Ami.
Yen tubusiɑnɑ n ǹ nɛn tɔmbu.
Domi i ǹ mɑɑ sɑ̃ɑ nɛn tɔmbu,
nɑ ǹ mɑɑ sɑ̃ɑ bɛɛn Yinni.
